description: Congressman Aaron Bean (FL-04), Chairman of the Early Childhood, Elementary, and Secondary Education Subcommittee, has introduced H.R. 8649, the Transparency in Reporting of Adversarial Contributions to Education (TRACE) Act. This legislation aims to safeguard America’s K-12 schools from the aggressive and systematic threats posed by foreign adversaries.
